overview_description.description:
Arden is an online shopping platform for women's clothing, shoes and accessories. In 1982, they started as an accessories and jewelry retailer, and today, they are on a whole new level - selling clothing, footwear, accessories, jewelry, activewear, intimates, and more.

With 375+ stores and a growing ecommerce business, they are inspired by the ever-changing world of our customer, social media, pop culture, fashion, and beauty. They believe that fashion shouldn’t be exclusive or intimidating; it should be celebrated with youthful confidence and fearless enthusiasm, inspiring girls and empowering them to be unique and individual.
